{{Quote|This is a diplomatic vessel of the Fifth Ruling Family, and we often welcome high-positioned officials aboard. Each social and professional position requires its own proper expanse, decor, and pattern. In each of those situations the reception area can be automatically reconfigured and decorated before the guest's arrival. As it is, the room is barely large enough to properly welcome a brother or sister of one of the Nine Families. Fortunately, most of them travel but little, and then mainly in vessels of their own.|Aristocra Chaf'orm'bintrano|<ref name="Survivor's Quest">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref>}}
'''Welcoming ceremony''' was a formal ceremony held by the [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Species/Legends|species]] for visiting [[Officer/Legends|officers]] and officials. The [[Crustai asteroid base]]<ref name="Outbound Flight" /> and the [[Cruiser/Legends|Chiss diplomatic vessel]] ''[[Chaf Envoy]]'' had [[welcoming chamber]]s to host such ceremonies.<ref name="Survivor's Quest" />

==History==
{{Quote|In the name of all who serve the Chiss, I greet you, Admiral Ar'alani.''"<br />"''I accept your greeting, and greet you in return, Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo. Do you guarantee my safety, and the safety of my crew?''"<br />"''I guarantee your safety with my life and the lives of those of my command. Enter in peace, and with trust.|Force Commander Mitth'raw'nuruodo and Admiral Ar'alani|<ref name="Outbound Flight" />}}
In [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Outbound Flight date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> [[Force Commander]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Mitth'raw'nuruodo]], [[Core name/Legends|core name]] "Thrawn," held a welcoming ceremony for [[Aristocra/Legends|Aristocra]] [[Chaf'orm'bintrano]], core name "Formbi," in a [[welcoming chamber]] at the [[Crustai asteroid base]]. In the same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Thrawn held the ceremony for [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Ar'alani/Legends|Ar'alani]] in the same chamber.<ref name="Outbound Flight" />
